title: dzkit rule
description: One rule, with every version it has had. Each version says when it applies and which sources back it.

id.description: Dotted identifier, e.g. payroll.irg-salary. Never changes once published.

review.description: How often the rule must be re-checked, and which events should trigger a check.

watch.description: Phrases that, when found in a new Journal officiel issue, may mean this rule changed. Matched without case or accents.

citation.description: A source id, or an object saying which articles of the source support which part of the data.

supports.description: Which part of the data this source supports.

valid_from.description: First day the version applies. null means it applied at least since the earliest source but the exact start is not recorded.

valid_to.description: Last day the version applies. null means still in force.

status.description: official: set by a binding text. confirmed: no binding text is published, but real examples match. convention: standard practice.

data.description: The rule's values. Their shape is specific to each rule and documented in the rule's description.
